glosses: Capable of surviving changes made in the future; not liable to become outdated.

examples.text: Videos recorded at a higher resolution are more future-proof since they can be viewed with more detail on higher resolution screens that one might own in future.
It’s not easy to buy a future-proof laptop because the industry is moving in the opposite direction.

glosses: To make ready to meet potential future requirements, or make use of potential future opportunities.

examples.text: While today’s most common image type, JPEG, had a few defenders, many believe it’s not a good candidate for future-proofing images because it is a “lossy” format.
